The course is divided into two parts. In the first part fish nutrition, nutritional requirements of individual fish species at different age groups will be covered. Feed production suitable for different production system and culture conditions will be discussed in the second part. Students are acquainted with the sources of individual nutrients and energy, feed components, technology of feed production and perspectives of their application, production and ecological aspects of fish feeding. Separate part is devoted to present status and trends in the area of research on fish nutrition and feeding. Practical part will deal with adapting feeding plans in accordance with the culture technology and execution and evaluation of feeding tests. Students will have visits to some feed producing plants. (allowance 21/21)
